text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: eval-gate/output-drift-detector for `billing-assistant` prompt family. Severity: P1. Page sent to oncall group.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert #PD-87432 - eval-gate triggered (output drift) — auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

jamal: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

priya: on-call-ml here — pinged. can you paste the failing eval summary?

jamal: putting initial findings: looks like a high regression in BLEU/ROUGE for templated responses, and safety filter false positives spiked. Quick summary: 12% of sampled responses are flagged for hallucination where baseline was ~1.2%.

sam: which deployment is affected? hosted or dedicated customers?

jamal: primarily Hosted API: region us-east-1, model set `rwd-llama-70b-q8` v2026-02-12. Also a small portion of Dedicated that are pinned to that exact model/version.

eva: thanks. I'm running the eval suite (1000-sample smoke) now against v2026-02-12 and v2026-01-30 (previous). sending logs to thread when done.

morgan-prodops: triage question — do we have evidence of user-facing errors / SLA breaches yet? any support tickets?

jamal: not many support tickets yet, but latency is normal. It's quality/regression only. A few internal customers reported odd outputs from a billing bot test client. No 5xx.

priya: initial eval diff: hallucination metric (fraction) v2026-02-12 = 0.124, v2026-01-30 = 0.013. Safety classifier false positive rate up 8x for one subset of prompts. This triggered the eval gate.

sam: suggested mitigation? fallback model? rollback? ramp down?

priya: immediate mitigations: 1) switch traffic for `billing-assistant` prompt family to `rwd-llama-70b-v2026-01-30` (previous stable) via routing policy. 2) If pinned Dedicated customers exist, send targeted notice and propose a hotfix rollout.

jamal: I'm going to run a routing override now for hosted — 10min canary -> 100% if green. executing: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"prompt_family":"billing-assistant","from":"rwd-llama-70b-q8@2026-02-12","to":"rwd-llama-70b@2026-01-30","canary_pct":10}'```

incident-bot: action logged: routing override initiated by jamal at 2026-03-14T15:02:12Z. Canary 10%.

priya: running regressions on the canary traffic: will monitor eval gate webhooks. ETA 6m.

eva: smoke eval results from canary (500 samples): hallucination frac = 0.015, safety FP close to baseline. Good so far.

jamal: ramping canary -> 100% now. ```curl -X POST ... 'canary_pct':100```

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert #PD-87432 acknowledged by jamal. Escalation canceled.

morgan-prodops: good. can you confirm which customer-facing routes were affected and approximate request volume? we'll need that for incident report and possible credits.

jamal: affected route: /v1/generate with route tag `team-billing`; estimated impacted requests ~3.2k in last 30m (~2.7% of total hosted traffic). Top customers by volume: acme-payments, ledgerly (both on hosted, not pinned).

sam: acme-payments contacted support with weird phrasing. can we draft a PD notice? short timeline and mitigation, no corrupted data, advised to re-run any critical flows.

priya: for Dedicated customers pinned to the bad version: list shows 2 orgs. I'll send a secure notice and offer rollback/assisted patch.

devon: logging a follow-up task: create blocking alert to detect >3% hallucination delta over baseline in next 24h to catch any regression reintroduction.

eva: root cause hypothesis: small change in decoding heuristics + quantization tweak in v2026-02-12 caused posterior mass to shift for templated prompts. We'll run ablation.

priya: long-term actions: revert the quantization tweak, run differential eval across prompt families, add a model rollout policy requiring extended eval gate for templated/safety-sensitive families.

jamal: incident status: mitigated (routing override -> previous stable model) at 2026-03-14T15:09:06Z. PagerDuty incident remains for postmortem tracking.

morgan-prodops: noting customer impact: ~3.2k requests, two support tickets, no downtime, quality regression affected specific prompt family. SLA/credits: assess but unlikely to meet threshold for credit.

priya: assigning owners: priya -> root cause & fix, eva -> eval/smoke suite improvements, jamal -> routing & oncall follow-ups, morgan-prodops -> customer comms.

jamal: I'll keep the routing override in place for 2h while we validate. If all green, we'll schedule a controlled re-release with fixes.

sam: thanks team. I'll convert this thread into an incident report draft and ping legal/SC when ready. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PD-87432: status=mitigated_by_routing_override, severity=P1, owner=jamal, created_at=2026-03-14T15:00:10Z, mitigated_at=2026-03-14T15:09:06Z.

jamal: closing thread for live ops. will update postmortem link once created.

morgan-prodops: thx — please add reproducible eval artifacts to the incident ticket.

(reacts: :eyes: by priya, :white_check_mark: by devon)
